purpose: One coarse swath screen per platform every 30 minutes; identifies candidate granules only, not fire labels or prediction performance.

source.dataset: NOAA VIIRS Enterprise Fire I-band EDR v1r3
source.screening_method: Minimum haversine distance from sampled route vertices to NOAA E-FIRE Sampled_Latitude/Longitude (24x100).

candidate_routes_within_40km: Bosque Tallado desde la plataforma del Piltriquitron

limitations: One granule per time interval can miss another granule in that interval; this is a coarse screen, not a complete coverage census.
The E-FIRE sampled geolocation is too coarse to assign its 375 m fire mask accurately to a trail.
A candidate within 40 km requires full granule GITCO geolocation and per-pixel quality screening before any label can be formed.
Missing swaths and invalid or cloudy pixels remain unknown, not fire-free.
